fusions.name: Deep-Set Gaff
fusions.desc: A barbed cut on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 8 seconds. Against a boss or elite it also takes 5% of its maximum health.

fusions.name: Rip It Loose
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A tearing cut that deals 9 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Reel Them In
fusions.desc: Hooks up to 4 enemies within 8 tiles and pulls them onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb in the Flesh
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
